title: Cycle tracking is too complicated.
body:
This app could really use some pointers from some period cycle tracking apps. It should not be this complicated! Especially for the cycle details in the “Your Cycles” section. If you’re going to show it like a chart, then please leave appropriate indications and legends on the rows and columns that you used. The most important info which would be the dates of the period is located at the very bottom without any indication of what those dates are LOL. I cannot stress that enough. 

The “highlights” section is enough for a tracker. Maybe just put dots with different colors for any symptoms experienced/activities for the day? AND PLEASE IF YOU’RE GOING THIS ROUTE, PUT LEGENDS.

Don’t make this so complicated!
